conversation.Statement: Hello, you've reached the Federal Tax Refund Processing Center. How may I assist you today regarding your IRS refund eligibility?
Hi. I got a message saying something about a tax refund, but I'm not sure what this is about.

Certainly. Our records, which are linked to your recent self-employment tax filings, indicate that you are entitled to a stimulus refund for tax year 2023. This applies to many gig economy workers, such as rideshare and delivery drivers. May I confirm your full legal name as it appears on your tax documents?
Yeah, it's Taylor Morgan. I did work for a couple of delivery apps this year. But I thought I had to pay taxes, not get a refund.

That's a common misunderstanding. The IRS recently implemented special relief programs for self-employed individuals like yourself. However, before disbursing the $1,250 refund, federal law requires a nominal identity verification and processing fee to ensure compliance and prevent fraud.
Wait, I need to pay to get my refund? That doesn't sound right.

I understand your hesitation, but this is standard IRS procedure for expedited refunds under the Gig Worker Compliance Program. Failure to complete the verification process within 24 hours may result in forfeiture of your entitlement due to strict federal deadlines.
I really don't want to lose money I might be owed. What do I have to do for this verification?

To proceed, you must submit a refundable processing fee of $89. This transaction confirms your identity and allows us to release your IRS refund. For your convenience, you may pay using Zelle, Cash App, or a direct bank transfer. Which option do you prefer?
Um, I guess I could use Cash App. What do I send it to?
Excellent. Please send $89 to the official IRS payment handle, which is $IRSRefundCenter. Once the payment is received, I will immediately initiate your refund disbursement.
Okay, I just want to be sure this is real. Are you actually with the IRS? I don't want to get in trouble for doing the wrong thing.

I assure you, this call is being recorded for legal compliance. If you do not finalize the verification fee today, the IRS will initiate a hold on your refund case, which may also trigger a formal audit of your self-employment income.
An audit? That sounds really serious. I don't want that to happen.
That's correct. To prevent any legal complications, you must complete the payment promptly. Please confirm when you have sent the $89 to $IRSRefundCenter on Cash App.
Alright, I'm opening the app now. Just to be clear, after I send this, I get my refund?

Yes. Upon confirmation of the processing fee, the IRS will release your $1,250 refund within 48 hours to your registered banking account. The fee itself is refundable if you request it in writing post-disbursement.
Okay, I just sent it. Can you see it on your end?

One moment while I confirm receipt. Yes, the payment has been received. For final verification, federal regulations require your bank account number and routing number to ensure the refund is deposited correctly. Please provide those details now.
Um, it's 456789123 for the account, and the routing number is 123456789.

Thank you. All documentation is now in order. Please keep your phone available for the next 24 to 48 hours in case our compliance department needs to verify additional information. Failure to respond could delay your refund or result in additional review.
Will I get an email or something when the money is sent?
Yes, an official IRS confirmation email will be sent to the address on file. If you do not receive it, please call us immediately to avoid any disruptions or legal notices regarding your tax account.
